title: Six trips for the tape
hook: You need the tape six times while you work.

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that each fetch repeats the round trip, so a few metres times many fetches adds up to a long walk, which a second copy at the desk removes

misconception: A short walk to fetch something is negligible, however often you make it.
objective: For the pictured task, retrieving the same supply across the room repeatedly multiplies the walking distance. A copy at the use point removes that route, at the cost of another storage location.
